name: super-casual
title: Super Casual UI Kit
description: Chunky, glossy mobile game UI for hyper-casual and casual 2D/3D web games. Plain HTML + CSS components that float above any game canvas (Three.js, Babylon, Phaser, PixiJS).

items.name: core
items.title: Core
items.description: Font, design tokens, color palette, outlined 3D text and glossy surface. Required by every component.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Chunky glossy game button with outlined 3D text.
items.whenToUse: Any action the player taps: play, retry, claim, buy, confirm, cancel.

data-badge.description: Corner count; requires components/bubble/bubble.css. See bubble component.

js.SC.setLabel(el, text): Change the label and keep the 3D text in sync
js.SC.setBadge(el, count, color?): Set the corner count (requires bubble CSS); null removes it.

rules: One lg button per screen for the main action
green = positive/continue/rewarded video, yellow = main play, red = destructive/quit, dark = cancel, purple = premium
Popups use sm or md; secondary left, primary right
Labels 1-2 words
Never override colors with custom CSS; use data-color

examples.title: Yes / No
examples.html:
<button class="sc-button" data-color="dark" data-size="sm">No</button>
<button class="sc-button" data-color="green" data-size="sm">Yes</button>

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Square or round button showing only an icon, with optional label underneath.
items.whenToUse: Pause, close, settings, back/next arrows, menu shortcuts (Daily, Mail, Shop).

aria-label.description: Required when there is no visible label

label.description: Plain text inside → label under the icon (use with flat)

data-badge.description: Corner count; requires components/bubble/bubble.css. See bubble component.

js.SC.setBadge(el, count, color?): Set the corner count (requires bubble CSS); null removes it.

rules: Pause in gameplay: top-left, ring or glossy sky
Close on popups: glossy red with data-icon="close", top-right
Glossy for important actions, flat for menus/navigation, ring over busy game scenes
Always add aria-label when there is no visible label
Only use icon names from icons; never invent names or draw icons with code

items.name: counter
items.title: Resource Counter
items.description: Icon + dark pill + number, with optional "+" button. Builds itself from attributes.
items.whenToUse: Showing coins, gems, energy, lives, tickets — usually top-right of the HUD or home screen.

data-plus.description: Adds a "+" button in this color

events.plus: Dispatched on the counter when its "+" button is tapped

js.SC.setValue(el, value, { animate }): Change the value with count-up animation and bump
js.SC.format(n, \"short\"): Format a number like counters do

rules: Top-right, 12px from edges; most important resource furthest right
"+" color matches resource: coin orange, gem purple, energy blue, cash/ticket green
Only add "+" when it opens a way to get more
Energy and lives use data-max
Use data-format="short" when values can pass 100,000
Always update with SC.setValue(); never write inner HTML or edit inner text

examples.title: HUD resources

items.name: slot
items.title: Reward Slot
items.description: Colored card with an item icon, count, optional tag and claimed/locked state. Builds itself from attributes.
items.whenToUse: Rewards, prizes, loot, shop contents, level requirements.

data-tag.description: Short label on top edge: BONUS, NEW, HOT, x2

data-badge.description: Corner count; requires components/bubble/bubble.css. See bubble component.

js.SC.setBadge(el, count, color?): Set the corner count (requires bubble CSS); null removes it.

rules: Rarity by color: white/dark common, green/sky uncommon, purple epic, yellow legendary, red special, lavender premium
Reward screens: 4-column grid, md size, reveal with SC.popIn()
Popups and rows: sm size
Tags: one short word or x2; at most one tagged slot per group
locked for unavailable rewards, claimed after collecting
Update counts with SC.setValue(); never write inner HTML

examples.title: Reward grid
States

items.name: popup
items.title: Popup
items.description: Modal window with header, title, optional sub tag and close button built automatically; author writes only the content.
items.whenToUse: Confirmations, level start info, pause menu, downloads, purchase confirm, any modal over the game.
items.html: Do you really want to exit the game?

slots.[data-close]: Any element that closes the popup when tapped

rules: blue = info/neutral, red = warning/hard/destructive, purple = premium/special
Title 1-3 words, message 1-2 sentences, at most 3 buttons
Two buttons: sm, secondary left, primary right; three or more: data-layout="stack"
Pause the game on open, resume on close
Required choices: data-closable="false" + data-backdrop="static"
Only one popup open at a time; never write the header or close button manually

examples.title: Pause menu
Level start

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Bar showing progress toward a goal, with optional label, left icon and star markers. Builds itself from attributes.
items.whenToUse: XP, level score, health, energy, loading, timers.
rules: green = health/level progress, blue = XP, orange = timers/loading, red = low health/danger, yellow = max/complete
Health: data-icon="heart" green; switch to red below 25%
Level goals in HUD: data-stars="33,66,100", no label
XP: data-label="value"
Always update with SC.setValue()
Width comes from the container

items.name: title
items.title: Screen Title
items.description: Big gradient headline with black outline, 3D edge and optional entrance animation.
items.whenToUse: Result and event screens: CLEAR!, FAILED, LEVEL UP, NEW RECORD, PAUSED.
rules: One title per screen, at the top
win gold+drop, fail red+shake, level up blue, reward purple+pop, neutral white
1-2 words, UPPERCASE, optional !
lg for result screens; md if longer than 8 letters
Not for popup headers (popups use data-title)

items.name: stars
items.title: Star Rating
items.description: Row or arc of filled/empty stars with pop-in animation. Builds itself from data-value.
items.whenToUse: Level results, level select buttons, item quality, ratings.

events.star: Fired as each earned star appears (detail.index)

rules: Result screens: arc + lg + data-animate, under the Screen Title
Fail screens: data-value="0", no animation
Level select/lists: sm, row
Play a sound on each star event
3 stars for levels; data-max="5" only for ratings/item quality

items.name: timer
items.title: Countdown Timer
items.description: Ring or pill countdown that starts when shown, warns near the end and fires done at 0.
items.whenToUse: Continue offers, level time limits, energy refills, limited-time events.

data-warn.description: Seconds left when it turns red and pulses

rules: Ring for short decisions (3-10s) with data-warn="3"
Pill for level clocks and refills; data-format="long" for multi-day events
Always handle the done event
Pause gameplay timers when the game pauses
Level time limits top-center in the HUD

items.name: float
items.title: Floating Text
items.description: JavaScript-only feedback text that floats up and fades at a tap, element or screen position.
items.whenToUse: Points, coins, damage, healing, XP, combos — anywhere the player needs instant feedback.

js.SC.float(text, target, { color, size, ic: Show floating text; target = pointer event | element | {x, y} | null (center)

rules: white points, gold coins, green heal/bonus, red damage/miss, sky XP, purple gems
Show it where the action happened
Tiny text: +/- numbers or one word
pop + lg only for special moments
Pair coin floats with SC.setValue() on the coin counter
For canvas objects convert world position to page pixels and pass {x, y}

examples.title: Combo
examples.js: SC.float('COMBO x3!', null, { size: 'lg', color: 'gold', style: 'pop' });

items.name: bubble
items.title: Count Bubble
items.description: Small glossy top-right count attached to a Button, Icon Button or Reward Slot.
items.whenToUse: Booster stock, unread messages or available rewards on an existing component.
items.html: <button class="sc-icon-button" data-icon="key" data-badge="3" aria-label="Key booster, 3 available"></button>

data-badge.description: Non-negative safe integer on the host. 0 is visible; >99 shows 99+. Missing, empty or invalid hides.

js.SC.setBadge(el, count, color?): Set count and optionally color. null removes the bubble. Existing color is preserved when omitted.

rules: Load bubble CSS plus the selected host component (button, icon-button or slot) and its dependencies; core alone does not style the host.
Set data-badge on the host; never write .sc-bubble markup by hand.
Leave at least 8px top/right outside the host; keep the entire badge within the screen margin and avoid clipping.
Zero remains visible; remove data-badge to hide. Disabling the host is a separate game decision.
Use data-badge-color for the bubble independently of the host data-color.
Keep accessible labels on icon-only buttons and slots in sync with the exact count.
Avoid overlap with long slot tags. Slot reward quantity stays bottom-right.

examples.title: Booster stock
examples.html: <button class="sc-icon-button" data-icon="key" data-badge="3" aria-label="Key booster, 3 available"></button>

examples.title: Unread messages
examples.html: <button class="sc-icon-button" data-icon="mail" data-badge="125" data-badge-color="red" aria-label="Mail, 125 unread"></button>

items.name: screen
items.title: Screen Shell
items.description: Full-page mobile layout above the game canvas: top bar, centered middle, bottom bar. Scales a 400x870 design to any phone, never scrolls, keeps 12px + safe-area edge margins.
items.whenToUse: The root of every full-page UI: gameplay HUD, start, pause, success, fail, shop, settings, loading.
items.html:
…
…
…

data-backdrop.description: none = game visible and tappable (HUD); dim = dark see-through, blocks game; solid = opaque dark

data-fit.description: parent = fill the parent box (previews only)

parts..sc-screen-top: Row at the top edge. data-align between|start|center|end (default between); data-stack = column.
parts..sc-screen-middle: Column filling the free space, content centered.
parts..sc-screen-bottom: Row at the bottom edge. data-align (default center); data-stack = column.

rules: Every full-page UI is one .sc-screen; never write custom scale/resize code or position:fixed layouts.
Never scroll; if content does not fit 400x870, remove or shrink it.
HUD: data-backdrop none. Menus/results over the game: dim. Screens replacing the game: solid.
Resources and pause in the top bar; main actions in the bottom bar; titles, stars, rewards in the middle.
Do not add edge margins or safe-area padding. Add viewport-fit=cover to the viewport meta.
One screen per layer at a time; switch with SC.screen.show/hide. Keep .sc-popup outside .sc-screen.
Size content for the 400px design width (width:100% inside a region, never 100vw).

examples.title: Gameplay HUD
Result screen
examples.html: CLEAR!

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Glossy ON/OFF settings switch with a sliding thumb, native keyboard activation and accessible state.
items.whenToUse: Binary settings that take effect immediately, such as sound, music and vibration.

data-checked.description: Bare or true means ON. Missing, false or invalid means OFF. Direct edits render silently.

data-color.description: ON color; OFF stays muted dark.

disabled.description: Native disabled attribute; blocks user interaction.

aria-label.description: Required stable setting name unless aria-labelledby references an external label.

aria-labelledby.description: External label ID; alternative to aria-label.

events.name: change
events.description: Bubbles once per user activation, after state updates. Helpers emit only when requested and changed.

js.SC.setChecked(el, boolean, {emit?}): Set state; alias of SC.toggle.set. Silent by default. emit:true notifies only on a changed value.
js.SC.toggle.set(el, boolean, {emit?}): Set state immediately. Requires a boolean. Can restore a disabled switch.

rules: Use a native button with only sc-toggle, and put the visible setting name outside.
Always supply a stable accessible name; runtime owns type=button, role=switch and aria-checked.
Set state through data-checked or SC.setChecked / SC.toggle. Do not set aria-checked or .checked.
Listen for change to apply and save settings; do not invert again in a click or key handler.
Use native disabled, not aria-disabled alone, to lock interaction.
Keep a consistent ON palette and preserve the 44px minimum height and focus outline space.
No image assets required. Do not use SC.setLabel or SC.setIcon on a toggle.
No automatic persistence or form submission; game code owns settings and side effects.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Glossy track with a round thumb for picking an amount. Drag, tap-to-jump and keyboard.
items.whenToUse: Sound/music volume, sensitivity, brightness, difficulty levels.

data-value.description: Snapped to step, clamped to range

events.input: Value changed while dragging or by key (detail.value)

js.SC.slider.set(el, value, {emit?}): Set value; silent unless emit:true; invalid values ignored

rules: Use for amounts; use Toggle for ON/OFF.
Always set aria-label and show a visible text label next to it.
Apply on input, save on change; restore saved values silently with SC.slider.set.
Fill the row; keep at least 160px wide.
Sound/music icons are not in the kit yet; use text labels.

examples.title: Difficulty 1-5

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Chunky tick box with optional outlined label; glossy colored box with the kit check icon when checked.
items.whenToUse: Choices listed together or confirmed later: don't show again, terms, mission checklists.

js.SC.checkbox.set(el, boolean, {emit?}): Silent unless emit; throws on non-boolean

rules: Checkbox for listed/confirmed choices; Toggle for instant settings.
Native <button>; label as text inside or aria-label when empty.
Listen for change; never add a click handler that flips state.
Use real booleans with SC.checkbox.set; never hand-build the box or draw a check.
Keep labels 1-4 words.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented row of 2-4 tabs; exactly one selected (glossy), others muted dark. Optional icons, badges and auto panels.
items.whenToUse: Switching lists inside a popup or screen: Daily/Weekly, Coins/Gems, Friends/Global, Skins/Items.

data-value.description: On .sc-tabs: selected tab value (default first enabled)

parts.button[data-value]: Each tab (required unique data-value). Optional data-icon, data-panel (element id to show when selected), data-badge, disabled.

js.SC.tabs.set(el, value, {emit?}): Select; silent unless emit; false if unknown/disabled

rules: 2-4 tabs, 1-word labels; use Bottom Tab Bar for main navigation.
Tabs are plain <button data-value> directly inside .sc-tabs; no classes/roles/click handlers by hand.
Prefer data-panel to show content; otherwise listen for change.
Full width at the top of a popup body or screen middle.
data-badge (red) for new items on a tab (load bubble.css).
Long labels shrink to fit (then the icon hides); still keep labels to one short word.

examples.title: Icons and panels

items.name: tabbar
items.title: Bottom Tab Bar
items.description: Bottom navigation bar for home/menu screens; selected item rises on a glossy block with its label. Badges and auto screen switching.
items.whenToUse: Main navigation between home-level screens (Shop, Chests, Play, Rank, Settings). Never during gameplay.

parts.button[data-value][data-icon]: Item; text = 1-word label; optional data-panel (screen id), data-badge, disabled

rules: Home/menu screens only; 3-5 items; main action in the middle.
Place in .sc-screen-bottom of its own always-visible .sc-screen layer; no margins (bleeds to edges).
Each item needs data-icon from the kit list and a 1-word label.
Switch screens with data-panel or listen for change.
Red badges for collectables, green for good news; clear when opened.

examples.title: Home navigation
examples.html: <nav class="sc-tabbar" data-value="play"><button data-value="shop" data-icon="cash" data-panel="shopScreen">Shop</button><button data-value="play" data-icon="star" data-panel="playScreen">Play</button><button data-value="rank" data-icon="trophy" data-badge="2" data-badge-color="green" data-panel="rankScreen">Rank</button></nav>

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag Ribbon
items.description: Small glossy sticker labels (NEW, HOT, SALE, -50%, x2), standalone or attached to buttons/icon buttons/tabs via data-tag.
items.whenToUse: Highlight a new, hot, discounted or boosted item.

parts..sc-tag: Standalone tag: data-color (default red), data-size sm|md|lg, data-tilt

rules: One short capital word.
red HOT/SALE, green NEW/FREE, yellow BEST, purple discounts, sky multipliers.
One tag per item; max 2-3 tagged items per screen.
Leave ~10px around tagged hosts; no overflow:hidden parent.
Starburst stickers are images; never draw them.

items.name: banner
items.title: Title Banner Ribbon
items.description: Ribbon banner with folded tails for short announcements above a character/reward.
items.whenToUse: NEW SKIN!, SEASON RESULT, LEVEL UP, BIG WIN above a reveal or result.
rules: 1-3 capital words; use Screen Title for CLEAR!/FAILED.
Centered above what it announces.
Leave ~1 banner-height of space on each side for tails.
pink new skin, orange season/results, purple rare, green level up.
data-animate=unfurl on reward reveals.

items.name: hint
items.title: Hint Bubble
items.description: White speech bubble with a pointer; tap-to-show via data-hint or programmatic tutorial hints.
items.whenToUse: Info explanations, item effects, tutorial steps.
items.html: <button class="sc-icon-button" data-icon="info" data-hint="Win 3 levels to unlock" aria-label="Info"></button>

data-hint.description: On any element: bubble text shown on tap

parts..sc-hint: Static bubble: data-pos top|bottom|left|right (side it sits on), data-size sm|md

js.SC.hint.show(target, text, {pos, duratio: Show floating bubble; duration 0 = stay; returns bubble or null

rules: Max ~8 words; longer text in a Popup.
data-hint on info buttons and non-obvious items.
Tutorials: SC.hint.show(..., {duration:0}); hide when the player acts; one at a time.
Pick the side with most free space.

examples.title: Tap to show

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast Message
items.description: Short self-hiding message pill at the top/bottom of the screen; queued; JS only.
items.whenToUse: Feedback for an action: not enough coins, saved, purchase complete, +1 life.

js.SC.toast(text, {kind, icon, duration, po: kind info|success|error|reward (default info); icon kit name; duration ms (default 1800); pos top|bottom (default top)

rules: 1-5 words; questions go in a Popup.
error = failed action, success = worked, reward = small gain, info otherwise.
Don't toast what is already visible; use SC.float near the object.
Top by default.
Never call every frame.

items.name: row
items.title: Item Row
items.description: Colored card row layout for missions, leaderboards and friend lists; filled with kit parts plus row parts.
items.whenToUse: Lists: daily missions, achievements, leaderboards, friends, inbox.
items.html: Win 3 levels
rules: Mission: white+Go in progress, yellow+orange Claim when complete, data-state=done + disabled dark Done after claim.
Leaderboard: data-variant=leader; player row yellow.
Column with 8-10px gaps inside popup body or screen middle; never scroll the page.
Short titles.
avatar/helmet icons for player pictures.

examples.title: Leaderboard row
examples.html: 4Player5154

items.name: loading
items.title: Loading Bar
items.description: Loading screen part: big progress bar with percent label, bouncing icon and rotating tips; done() hides its screen.
items.whenToUse: Game start while assets load.
items.html: MY GAME

js.SC.loading.done(el): Fill, fire done, hide parent screen

rules: Solid Screen Shell: title middle, .sc-loading bottom.
Real progress, never backwards.
2-5 short tips.
Start the game on done.

items.name: alert
items.title: Notification Dot
items.description: Red '!' icon or small dot on a host corner meaning something new (no number).
items.whenToUse: New mail, free reward available, unlocked item, unseen tab.
rules: No number; counts use data-badge; never both.
Clear when opened.
Max 2-3 per screen; dot for secondary.
Update host aria-label.

items.name: level
items.title: Level Badge
items.description: Shield badge with the level number; standalone or on a Progress Bar's left end (XP bar).
items.whenToUse: Player level, hero/item level, XP bars.

data-level (on .sc-progress).description: Badge on the bar's left end

rules: Player/hero/item levels and XP bars.
No data-icon together with data-level on a bar.
Pop only on real level-ups.
Max 3 digits.

items.name: topbar
items.title: Top Bar
items.description: Home screen top bar: avatar + level + name (profile button) on the left, resource counters on the right.
items.whenToUse: Top of home/menu screens.
rules: Home/menu screens only, in .sc-screen-top.
sm counters, short format for big numbers.
Max 3 resources (2 with a name).
Open profile on the profile event.

examples.title: Home top bar

items.name: shopcard
items.title: Shop Card
items.description: Shop offer card with pack picture, amount, optional tag/bonus and a price button; fires buy.
items.whenToUse: Shop screens and offer popups: currency packs, lives, chests, boosters.
rules: 2-3 per row; same color per currency.
gem-pile/coin-pile for currency packs.
Max one BEST and one discount tag per row.
Handle buy: check balance, toast if short, update counters.
Never fake real-money purchases.

examples.title: Coin price

items.name: tutorial
items.title: Tutorial Hand
items.description: Animated pointing hand for tutorials (tap/swipe/drag) with optional spotlight and hint; promise-based steps.
items.whenToUse: First-time tutorials and gameplay gesture hints.

js.await SC.tutorial.point(target, {gesture: gesture tap|swipe-up|swipe-down|swipe-left|swipe-right|drag; resolves true on target tap, false if cleared/replaced

rules: One step at a time; await each point().
Spotlight for menu steps; off for gameplay gestures.
Hint text ~6 words, action first.
Only the first time; save progress.
Swipes point at a big element.

examples.title: Two steps
examples.js: await SC.tutorial.point(playBtn, { text: 'Tap Play!' }); await SC.tutorial.point(gift, { text: 'Open your gift' });

icons.note: Use by name with data-icon (arrow-left is arrow-right mirrored). Every icon attribute also accepts a path, web address or data: image (e.g. data-icon="images/fox.png"). SC.setImage(name, src) replaces a picture for the whole page, including built-ins: check, lock, alert, level-badge, hand, avatar, star, star-empty. New pictures: kit/assets/IMAGE-PROMPTS.md.

blocks.name: hud
blocks.title: Gameplay HUD
blocks.description: In-game overlay: pause button, star-marker score bar, coins, lives, timer pill, booster buttons with counts, pause popup.
blocks.whenToUse: Any level-based or score-based game while playing.

blocks.name: success
blocks.title: Success
blocks.description: Level complete: title, star rating, XP bar with level badge, reward slots, Claim / x2 Claim, Home.
blocks.whenToUse: After the player wins a level.

blocks.name: fail
blocks.title: Fail
blocks.description: Level failed: title, empty stars, so-close progress, timed continue offer (video/gems), Retry, Give up.
blocks.whenToUse: When the player loses a level.

blocks.name: pause
blocks.title: Pause
blocks.description: Pause popup over the game with quick setting toggles and Resume / Restart / Home.
blocks.whenToUse: When the player pauses during a level.

blocks.name: start
blocks.title: Start
blocks.description: Home screen: top bar, side shortcuts with alerts/badges/tags, title + PLAY, bottom tab bar switching screens.
blocks.whenToUse: Main menu of casual games with meta features.

blocks.name: reward
blocks.title: Reward Reveal
blocks.description: Chest opening / new item reveal: banner, shaking chest, item pop with glow, rarity tag, reward slots, Collect.
blocks.whenToUse: Opening chests, unlocking skins/characters, big rewards.

blocks.name: daily
blocks.title: Daily Reward
blocks.description: 7-day daily reward popup with claimed/today/future states, big day-7 chest, Claim and next-reward countdown.

blocks.name: settings
blocks.title: Settings
blocks.description: Settings popup: toggles + volume sliders, vibration, language tabs, notifications checkbox, support/privacy/restore, version.
blocks.whenToUse: Game settings from the menu or pause screen.

blocks.name: shop
blocks.title: Shop
blocks.description: Shop screen: wallet counters, timed offer row, tabbed shop card grids, buy handling with balance checks.
blocks.whenToUse: In-game store for currency packs and items.

blocks.name: loading-screen
blocks.title: Loading
blocks.description: Start-up flow: title + loading bar with tips → PLAY / tap to start → game HUD.
